description: This Java source file defines a helper class 'FeignJournalEntryHelper' used in integration tests for interacting with and verifying journal entries related to loans via the Fineract Feign client. It provides methods to retrieve journal entries for a specific loan and verify their correctness against expected data.

classes.name: FeignJournalEntryHelper
classes.description: Helper class for integration tests to fetch and verify journal entries for a specific loan using the Fineract Feign client.

methods.name: FeignJournalEntryHelper
methods.description: Constructor initializing the helper with a FineractFeignClient instance.

methods.name: getJournalEntriesForLoan
methods.description: Retrieves all journal entries associated with the specified loan ID.

methods.name: verifyJournalEntries
methods.description: Verifies that the journal entries for a loan match expected entries in content and count.

methods.name: verifyJournalEntriesSequentially
methods.description: Sequentially verifies journal entries, essentially a wrapper around verifyJournalEntries.
